# 2.4.8 Location (Level AAA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.4 Navigable
- Level: AAA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/location.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#location

## Normative text

Information about the user's location within a [set of web pages](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-set-of-web-pages) is available.

## Sufficient techniques

- G65: Providing a breadcrumb trail
- G63: Providing a site map
- G128: Indicating current location within navigation bars
- ARIA26: Using aria-current to identify the current item in a set
- G127: Identifying a web page's relationship to a larger collection of web pages
